title: Butang Kedua
genre: Malay zapin acoustic ballad (gambus/oud, marwas, accordion, steady 4/4 zapin rhythm)
subject: A Johor wife sews back the second button on her husband's shirt every Sunday before he crosses the Causeway for work in Singapore, and it always comes loose by Wednesday
caption: Malay zapin acoustic, ballad-leaning sub-style with a steady 4/4 zapin rhythm. Gambus oud playing ringing plucked melodic phrases and answer lines, marwas hand drums keeping a steady zapin pattern, accordion holding warm long chords under the chorus, upright bass plucked softly. Close warm acoustic room, natural reverb, unprocessed. Female alto lead, mid-low register, restrained vibrato, plain tender delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 84 BPM, D minor. Wistful, tender, warm mood. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synth, no autotune, no rap, no trap hi-hats.
lyrics:
[Intro - gambus, marwas]

[Verse 1]
Setiap Ahad petang dia ke Woodlands
Beg kecil, kemeja biru dilipat
Butang kedua selalu tertanggal
Aku jahit semula, benang hitam

[Pre-Chorus]
Jarum masuk, jarum keluar
Hari Ahad jadi panjang

[Chorus]
Butang kedua, jangan lagi tanggal
Biar dia ingat jalan pulang
Seminggu di seberang, aku tunggu
Dengan jarum dan lampu dapur

[Verse 2]
Dia gelak, kata butang pun rindu rumah
Aku kata, jangan pandai-pandai
Hari Rabu telefon, butang dah jatuh
Aku diam, dengar bunyi bas

[Pre-Chorus]
Jarum masuk, jarum keluar
Tiga simpulan, supaya kuat

[Chorus]
Butang kedua, kau pegang erat
Biar dia ingat jalan pulang
Jumaat malam dia ketuk pintu
Kemeja yang sama, butang yang sama

[Bridge - gambus and accordion]
Satu butang kecil, satu rumah besar
Dia pegang butang, aku pegang dia

[Outro - gambus fades]
Butang kedua, butang kedua
Ahad depan aku jahit lagi
